units.source_text: 实际上，父亲的灵枢安放得适得其所，好像是镶嵌在万事俱备的氛围中。

en.t: In fact, my father's coffin had been placed exactly where it belonged, as though it were fitted into an atmosphere in which everything was already prepared.

units.source_text: 母亲、小和尚以及施主们聚在灵前哭泣。

en.t: My mother, the young acolyte, and the temple patrons gathered before the coffin and wept.

units.source_text: 小和尚结结巴巴的诵经，仿佛一半也是仰仗灵枢里的父亲的指示。

en.t: The young acolyte chanted the sutra haltingly, as though he too were half relying on instructions from my father inside the coffin.
